# ShieldCaptcha Enterprise

> Open-source, zero-cookie autonomous bot defense and enterprise Proof-of-Work human verification platform. Engineered as a privacy-preserving alternative to Google reCAPTCHA, Cloudflare Turnstile, and hCaptcha.

- Full Documentation: https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
- Official Repository: https://github.com/Tusharsinghoffical/ShieldCaptcha
- Author: Tushar Singh (https://codewithmrsingh.me/)
- License: MIT License (Free & Open Source)

## Core Documentation & Pages

- [Overview](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/): Executive summary, live playground, and defense performance metrics.
- [Interactive Demo](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/demo): Real-time interactive verification testing 1-Click PoW and anti-CV jigsaw puzzles.
- [Developer Documentation](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/docs): Comprehensive quickstart, REST API reference, and server verification endpoints.
- [Security Architecture](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/architecture): Detailed breakdown of 4-tier defense: SHA-256 PoW, AES-CBC-128 encryption, kinematics physics, and telemetry audits.
- [Integration Hub](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/integration): Drop-in SDKs and code samples for React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Python FastAPI, and HTML.
- [Attack Simulator](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/simulator): Interactive defense lab testing resistance against Selenium, Puppeteer, synthetic clicks, and teleportation attacks.
- [Security Policy](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/security): Cryptographic threat model, zero-trust posture, and vulnerability disclosure policy.
- [Enterprise Trial](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/trial): Instant onboarding and credential provisioning for development environments.
- [Contact & Support](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/contact): Technical support channels and enterprise inquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/privacy): Zero-cookie privacy guarantees, GDPR, CCPA, and India DPDP Act compliance.
- [Terms of Service](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/terms): Open-source licensing terms for cloud-managed and self-hosted deployments.

## Key Technical Specifications

- **Zero Tracking Cookies**: Drops no third-party cookies or session identifiers. 100% compliant with GDPR, CCPA, and India DPDP Act without requiring cookie consent banners.
- **Client-Side Proof-of-Work (PoW)**: Multi-threaded background Web Worker computes dynamic SHA-256 leading-zero challenges in under 20ms for humans, imposing exponential compute cost on mass scrapers.
- **Biomechanical Kinematics**: Analyzes mouse and touch pointer trajectory curvature, micro-jitter, and jerk derivatives (Flash & Hogan minimum-jerk model) to distinguish biological humans from automated headless bots.
- **Single-Use HMAC-SHA256 Token Vault**: Server issues cryptographically signed authorization nonces with atomic replay protection and 300-second expiration.
- **Self-Hostable Dual Engines**: Run standalone via Docker Compose with zero-dependency Node.js native engine or Python 3.11+ FastAPI engine.
- **Developer Packages**: Official packages `@shieldcaptcha/core`, `@shieldcaptcha/widget`, `@shieldcaptcha/react` available via npm.

## Quick Integration

### Client-Side (HTML / Vanilla JS)
```html
<script src="https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/captcha.js" async></script>
<div id="shield-captcha" data-sitekey="YOUR_SITE_KEY" data-callback="onShieldSuccess"></div>
<script>
  function onShieldSuccess(token) {
    console.log("Verified ShieldCaptcha Token:", token);
  }
</script>
```

### Client-Side (React / Next.js)
```tsx
import { ShieldCaptcha } from "@shieldcaptcha/react";

export function LoginForm() {
  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleLogin}>
      <ShieldCaptcha
        siteKey="YOUR_SITE_KEY"
        onVerify={(token) => setCaptchaToken(token)}
      />
      <button type="submit">Log In</button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

### Server Verification (Node.js / Express)
```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/api/siteverify", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    secret: process.env.SHIELD_SITE_SECRET,
    token: req.body["shield-captcha-token"],
  }),
});
const data = await res.json();
if (!data.success) throw new Error("Bot verification failed");
```
